desc: Implement modular arithmetic and precompute factorials/inverses for combinations up to $W+H+2$.
Write a function to compute sum of $\binom{i+j+2}{i+2}$ for $0 \le i \le W, 0 \le j \le H$ efficiently.
Calculate the number of bad paths by summing contributions from the left edge and bottom edge of the hole.
Subtract bad paths from total paths modulo 998244353.
